nodes.description: Constant public string VERSION = "0.3.2".
Public mapping address=>Limit holding the white list entries.
Public uint16 chunk counter, incremented in addPack.
Public uint counting inserted records, increased by array length in addPack.
Public uint256 integrity checksum of the white list, updated with additions/removals.
Public bool flag controlling setup mode, starts true and is disabled by start().
Public address of the administrator, set in constructor and by setAdmin().
Fallback function that always throws (explicitly unpayable).
Constructor assigning admin = msg.sender.
External setupOnly/adminOnly function adding a batch of addresses with min/max limits to the white list.
Public adminOnly function switching off setup mode.
Public adminOnly function changing the administrator address.
Modifier reverting unless isSetupMode is true.
Modifier reverting unless msg.sender equals admin.
Caller-controlled address used for admin assignment and access control checks.
controlSum -= uint160(addr) + lim.min + lim.max; unchecked subtraction that can underflow.
controlSum += uint160(addr) + min + max; unchecked addition that can overflow.
chunkNr++ inside require; unchecked uint16 increment that can overflow.
recordNum += len; unchecked addition that can overflow.
Array of addresses supplied by the caller.
Array of minimum limits (finney) supplied by the caller.
Array of maximum limits (finney) supplied by the caller.
Expected chunk number supplied by the caller and matched against chunkNr.
New administrator address supplied by the caller.
Local copy of addrs.length used for loops and record counting.
Loop index iterating over the supplied arrays.
Local address taken from addrs[i].
Local maximum limit taken from maxs[i].
Local minimum limit taken from mins[i].
Local copy of the existing Limit record for addr.

edges.reason: addrs parameter is iterated inside addPack.
mins parameter supplies min limits inside addPack.
maxs parameter supplies max limits inside addPack.
_chunkNr parameter is compared with chunkNr inside addPack.
newAdmin parameter becomes the new privileged admin address.
len is added to recordNum without overflow protection.
loop index i drives iteration in addPack.
caller supplied addr feeds the unchecked controlSum addition.
caller supplied max feeds the unchecked controlSum addition.
caller supplied min feeds the unchecked controlSum addition.
lim holds the previously stored Limit read from allowed[addr].
addPack writes and deletes entries in the allowed mapping.
addPack reads the existing Limit from the allowed mapping.
addPack mutates the controlSum checksum.
addPack increments chunkNr.
addPack increases recordNum.
constructor assigns the admin state variable.
start() writes false into isSetupMode.
setAdmin writes a new value into the admin state variable.
setupOnly modifier reads isSetupMode.
adminOnly compares caller-controlled msg.sender against admin.
constructor trusts msg.sender as the initial admin.
addPack is guarded by the setupOnly modifier.
addPack is guarded by the adminOnly modifier.
start is guarded by the adminOnly modifier.
setAdmin is guarded by the adminOnly modifier.
unchecked subtraction of uint160(addr)+lim.min+lim.max from controlSum can underflow.
unchecked addition into controlSum can overflow.
chunkNr++ can overflow the uint16 counter.
recordNum += len can overflow.
addPack executes the controlSum subtraction when an old record exists.
addPack executes the controlSum addition when max > 0.
addPack executes the chunkNr increment inside require.
addPack executes recordNum += len after the loop.

New admin parameter is only meaningful as input to the setAdmin core function.

Loop counter local exists only to drive iteration within addPack.

Local max value flows directly into the unchecked controlSum arithmetic.
